description.zh:
API的版本号。
>调用[DescribeGroupProductions](~~DescribeGroupProductions~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The API version number.

> Call the [DescribeGroupProductions](~~DescribeGroupProductions~~) API to get this parameter.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认值为**zh**。取值：
- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for requests and responses. The default value is **zh**. Values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

description.zh: 阿里云产品接口的POP CODE。
description.en: The POP CODE of the Alibaba Cloud product API.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member whose perspective the administrator switches to.

description.zh:
视图类型，默认为0。取值：

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type. The default is 0. Values:

- 0: Current Alibaba Cloud account view.

- 1: View of all accounts under the enterprise.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解响应编排产品（即威胁分析与响应日志接入流量）的收费方式和[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas)。
descriptions.en: Before you use this API, review the billing methods and [pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product#/sas/detail/sas) for the orchestration product, which supports threat analysis, response, log access, and traffic monitoring.
